audio_prompts.purpose: Listening model for Week 13 design-feedback identification using the reusable image A to image D gallery.
audio_prompts.script: Look at image A to image D. Number one: I like the dress because the color palette is soft and calm. The flowy fabric works well. You could add a small detail near the neckline. Number two: I like the jacket because it is modern and practical. The zipper and pockets work well. Maybe you could add more contrast to the color palette. Number three: The strongest part is the bright silhouette. The wide pants create an energetic mood. You could clarify the caption and make the main idea clearer. Number four: I like the textured detail because it looks balanced and elegant. The overall look is clear. Maybe you could simplify one extra decoration.
audio_prompts.speaker_profile: One adult teacher or Fashion Design classroom instructor speaking clearly to beginner learners.
audio_prompts.accent_or_variety: Clear international English suitable for Brazilian A2 learners.
audio_prompts.voice_direction: Warm, clear, and easy to follow, with short pauses after each number and slight emphasis on the main strength and suggestion in each comment.
audio_prompts.suggested_openai_voice_role: Choose an available OpenAI or ChatGPT voice at generation time that sounds like a supportive classroom teacher.
